label: Australian Superannuation Guarantee
field.name: Name
field.priorEarnings: Qualifying earnings already paid this financial year
field.continueContributions: Continue employer contributions after pension starts
field.cessation: An employment arrangement ends at age 60 or later by this start
help.earnings: Enter regular qualifying earnings for one employer. From July 2026 the forecast credits 12% up to the employer’s annual earnings cap, less 15% standard contributions tax.
help.priorEarnings: For a plan starting after 1 July, enter the same employer’s prior qualifying earnings since 1 July. These count toward the cap and any related contributions belong in the existing balance.
help.continueContributions: Select this if the same modeled earnings continue after the pension starts. New employer contributions accumulate separately from the pension.
help.return: Enter a nominal return after fees and fund earnings tax. The forecast applies it to both portions of the balance.
help.start: The forecast starts in the first full eligible month. The standard release age is 65, or 60 with qualifying employment cessation.
help.cessation: Confirm this only if an employment arrangement has ended at age 60 or older by the chosen start. Age 65 allows access even while employed.
help.cap: Use the available cap from the ATO. The 2026/27 general cap is AUD 2.1 million. Any excess stays in accumulation.
help.withdrawal: Enter zero for statutory minimum withdrawals. If you enter an amount, the forecast still pays at least the minimum while the pension has funds.
summary.pending: Start depends on the selected milestone
invalid.owner: Choose a member with a known birth year and month.
invalid.start: Choose a valid age, date or milestone.
invalid.prior: Prior qualifying earnings apply only when the plan starts after 1 July within a year covered by Payday Super.
invalid.taxCountry: The superannuation calculation supports Australian tax residence or a plan without tax.
